verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. For the constructed fields the display is stated by CrossBasedMeanComposition.bandSignedStage_mean_debt_of_cross_defects (CrossBasedMeanComposition.lean:271), which has no NativeData argument and holds for every SignedMeanGain.Geometry, including ActualInitialization.geometry. Its last five conjuncts are, for the stage output v = waveStage ... (the state after pressure reconstruction): the theta and axial residuals in MeanClass G.strip (1+sigma-2*kappa), their meanBar averages in MeanClass G.strip (1+sigma+17/100), and DefectBounds G.slowStrip (sigma-2*kappa) c v, which unfolds to UnweightedClass G.slowStrip (1+(sigma-2*kappa)) for each of the three debt rows (P, J_theta, J_z). With C_* = 1+sigma these are the four clauses of (9.14) with the same exponents, so the display follows by projecting conjuncts and unfolding DefectBounds; the classes are uniform in the band n, so the statement covers all bands with no band restriction in the conclusion. This theorem is the one on the path to the main chain: CorrectionAnalyticStep.step calls CycleParameters.mean_gain_from_waves_of_cross_defects, which calls fourStage_mean_gain_of_cross_defects, whose proof obtains the (9.14) block from bandSignedStage_mean_debt_of_cross_defects and hands it to CorrectionStep.meanStages_constructed; ActualStageEstimates.RunData.result applies step on ActualInitialization.geometry with kappa = ChartScales.kappa = 1/100000. What differs from the paper is the route to the hypothesis, not the display. The paper gets the bar gain from exact equality of the cross term with Sigma. The Lean theorem instead assumes the literal cross defect meanBar(crossTensor) - physicalSigma lies in MeanClass (1+sigma+17/100+kappa); on the actual chart the exact identity is only available for bands n >= (choice B N0).prepared.N + 1 (ActualSignedMeanBinding.family_requested_cross_tail, used as StepData.cross_tail by ActualCyclePreservation.stepData_of_waves), and SignedCrossDefectClass.residual_defects_all_exponents_of_primitive promotes that tail identity plus a baseline class to every exponent, keeping the finitely many earlier bands in the constant. The full four-clause conjunction is not exported as a single declaration specialised to the actual iterates: for them only E_theta, E_z in M_H (StepResult.afterSignedTheta/afterSignedAxial) and (P, J_theta, J_z) in S_H (ActualIntermediateDebtBounds.stage_debt_from_stepData, on ActualInitialization.slowStrip) are stated separately, while the averaged clause at C_*+0.17 is stated only in the general theorems at lines 140 and 271 and consumed inside the proof of fourStage_mean_gain_of_cross_defects. The earlier pairing cited SignedMeanGain.native_signed_mean_gain as stating the mean clauses; that theorem takes B : SignedMeanGain.NativeData G, which ActualSignedMeanBinding.no_legacy_nativeData shows is empty on ActualInitialization.geometry, so it is vacuous on the actual chart and is dropped. The NativeData chain (native_signed_mean_gain, BandReindexedSignedMeanGain.native_signed_mean_gain, CorrectionStep nativeSignedStage_mean_debt and bandNativeSignedStage_mean_debt, CorrectionStep fourStage_mean_gain, CycleParameters.mean_gain_from_waves) all take SignedMeanGain.NativeData G and ends at mean_gain_from_waves, which has no caller. ActualWaveRegularity.NativeData is a different structure (over CopyData, StripData, GraphDirections) and is not involved. The earlier pairing also cited CorrectionStep.CycleParameters.finish_mean_stages as where the conjunction is used; that theorem has no caller in NavierStokes/, and the hypothesis block actually consumed is the identical one of CorrectionStep.meanStages_constructed (:8021), cited instead. GaugeDebtIncrement.waveStage_defectBounds and the four definitions are unaffected and kept; waveStage_defectBounds is instantiated with alpha = 1+sigma-kappa and tau = sigma-2*kappa, not at C_*+0.17.
